extension.description: A window onto the world's oceans, only while your editor is empty. Experimental native wallpaper.
setting.interval: Minutes between photographs. Run Enable / Apply Ocean Wallpaper after changing settings.
setting.brightness: Photograph brightness (0–1). Editor text and chat colors are unaffected.
setting.caption: Show the location below each photograph.
setting.refresh: Hours before refreshing the online photograph catalog.
setting.count: Maximum photographs in the online catalog. The available count depends on the source.
